title: Archive very old Read Later tabs to Readeck or Linkding
intent: Consider a later lifecycle stage that saves Read Later tabs older than a configurable age to a self-hosted read-it-later/bookmark service, then removes the browser tabs. This must remain opt-in and preserve the project's no-surprise data-loss contract.

checklist.text: Compare Readeck and Linkding APIs and preserved page metadata
Define age threshold, confirmation/undo, and failure behavior
Only close a tab after remote archival has been verified
